subject: [RFC PATCH 04/57] mm/collapse: rename mthp_present_ptes to eligible_ptes

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch renames the 'mthp_present_ptes' bitmap to 'eligible_ptes' in the Linux kernel's memory management (mm) module. The rename is motivated by the fact that a bit being set in this bitmap does not necessarily mean the page is present, but rather that it has passed certain checks during a scan. The patch makes no functional changes and only updates the naming of the bitmap to better reflect its meaning.
